About this Event

CHAND SE DIYE TAK – Celebrating Pre-Karwa Chauth & Diwali with Love, Lights & Togetherness!
We are honored to dedicate the event to supporting the missions of Global Youth Empowerment Foundation (GYEF).
This festive season, come together for an evening where tradition meets celebration — filled with love, laughter, music, dance and beautiful community moments.
Saturday, October 24 | 5:30 PM – 9:00 PM
Amador Elementary School
2100 E. Cantara Dr., Dublin, CA 94568
Evening Highlights:
• FREE Couple Dance Lesson | 6:30–7:00 PM
• Couple Games
• Karaoke
• Dance
• Fashion Shows
• Karwa Chauth & Diwali Special Shopping
• Food available for purchase
Tickets:
10 yrs & up – $25
Kids 4–7 yrs – $15
Early Bird Special & Group Discounts Available!
Presented by Bollywood Dance Connection, VDesiJam & In Pursuit Talent Productions, while supporting the mission of Global Youth Empowerment Foundation (GYEF).
Come dressed festive, bring your family and friends, and celebrate the beautiful journey from Chand to Diye with us!
